study_design: Synthetic direct membrane feeding experiments; one independent blood sample per row.

fields.asexual_per_ul: Circulating asexual parasites per microlitre measured by SBP1 qRT-PCR.
fields.female_gametocytes_per_ul: Female gametocytes per microlitre measured by Pfs25 qRT-PCR.
fields.male_gametocytes_per_ul: Male gametocytes per microlitre measured by PfMGET qRT-PCR.
fields.mosquitoes_examined: Number of fed mosquitoes examined for oocyst infection.
fields.mosquitoes_infected: Number of examined mosquitoes with at least one oocyst; present only in the training file.

notes: All parasite densities are positive and above their assay's quantification limit.
Molecular density is a measured biomarker, not a direct count of viable or infectious gametocytes.
The files contain no repeated participants or study sites requiring clustered effects.
